# From exam chaos to calm — build a weekly study plan in 10 minutes

**Hook:** Imagine opening your calendar on Sunday night and seeing every exam, quiz and assignment laid out in colour-coded blocks. You’ll know exactly what to study each day and when to take breaks. Meta AI can build that plan for you in under ten minutes, even if you’re starting from scratch.

## Before you start
- A phone, tablet or computer with the **Meta AI app** (iOS/Android) or **Meta website** open in a browser.
- A free **Meta account** (sign-up takes 2 minutes).
- Your exam dates, quiz dates and assignment deadlines written down or in your calendar.
- Roughly **10 minutes** of quiet time.

---

## Step 1 — Open Meta AI and start a fresh chat
Open the **Meta AI app** on your phone or go to [meta.ai](https://meta.ai) in any browser. On the home screen you’ll see a search bar and a list of recent chats. Tap the **plus icon** (a circle with a pencil inside) or the “New chat” button to begin a fresh conversation. A blank chat screen appears with a blinking cursor ready for your first message.

You’ll know it worked when you see a clean chat window and the prompt “Ask Meta AI anything…” at the bottom.

💬 Example:
*Just open the app or website.*

---

## Step 2 — Tell Meta AI your courses and dates
In the chat box, type a clear message that lists each course, its exam date, any quizzes, and assignment deadlines. Use simple bullet points so the AI can read them easily.

For example:
“Here are my courses and dates:
- Maths exam 15 June
- History essay due 20 June
- Chemistry quiz 12 June
- English speech 25 June”

After you press send, Meta AI will reply with a short summary confirming it understood everything.

You’ll know it worked when you see a reply that repeats your courses and dates back to you.

💬 Example:
*Maths exam 15 June, History essay due 20 June, Chemistry quiz 12 June, English speech 25 June*

---

## Step 3 — Ask for a weekly study plan
On the same chat line, type:
“Create a 7-day study plan that spreads the work evenly and includes short breaks.”

Meta AI will reply with a colour-coded weekly calendar. Each day shows which topics to study and when to take 10-minute breaks. If the reply feels too long, ask for a shorter version by typing “Make it more compact.”

You’ll know it worked when you see a calendar with dates, study blocks, and break reminders.

💬 Example:
*Create a 7-day study plan that spreads the work evenly and includes short breaks.*

---

## Step 4 — Adjust the plan to fit your life
Look at the plan Meta AI gave you. If an evening block feels too late, reply:
“Move the Maths block to 4 pm each day instead.”

If you already have a part-time job on Wednesdays, say:
“Remove Wednesday evening and shift those hours to Thursday morning.”

Meta AI will update the calendar instantly. If the button you expect isn’t there, look for a small “Edit” or “Regenerate” link near the plan.

You’ll know it worked when the calendar updates and the new times appear.

💬 Example:
*Move the Maths block to 4 pm each day instead.*

---
## Step 5 — Ask for topic breakdowns
Pick one course from the plan and ask Meta AI to break it into smaller topics. For example:
“For Maths, list the exact chapters and topics I should study each day.”

Meta AI will reply with a detailed checklist. If the list feels overwhelming, ask for “only the top three topics per day.” If you prefer flashcards, say “turn the list into flashcard questions.”

You’ll know it worked when you see a clear checklist or flashcard list for that day.

💬 Example:
*For Maths, list the exact chapters and topics I should study each day.*

---
## Step 6 — Save or export the plan
At the bottom of the chat, look for a small **share icon** (an arrow pointing up or three connected dots). Tap it and choose “Copy” to save the plan to your phone’s notes or “Save as image” to add it to your calendar app. If you don’t see the icon, look for a menu with “Export” or “Share.”

You’ll know it worked when you can paste the plan into another app or save it as an image.

💬 Example:
*Tap the share icon and choose “Copy.”*

---
## Step 7 — Set phone reminders
Open your phone’s calendar or reminder app and paste the copied plan into tomorrow’s events. Set each study block as a calendar event with a 10-minute alert. If you prefer voice reminders, ask Meta AI to “turn the plan into voice reminders” and follow the link it provides.

You’ll know it worked when tomorrow’s events appear in your calendar with study blocks and alerts.

💬 Example:
*Paste the plan into tomorrow’s calendar events.*

---

## Common mistakes
- **Too vague a prompt:** Writing “Plan my study” gives a messy reply. Fix: list your courses and dates clearly.
- **Ignoring breaks:** Meta AI may pack blocks too tightly. Fix: reply “add a 10-minute break every 50 minutes.”
- **Not editing:** The first plan might clash with your job or sport. Fix: ask Meta AI to shift or remove blocks until it fits.

---

## What this means for you
- **In everyday life:** Use this plan to stay on track without last-minute cramming. You’ll finish each day knowing exactly what you accomplished.
- **For your business or work:** The same technique works for project deadlines and client deliverables—just swap “exam” for “milestone.”
- **If you're just getting started:** Start with one small course and build the habit of reviewing the plan each morning.

---
## Try it now
Open Meta AI, paste your courses and dates, and ask for a weekly study plan. You’ll have a colour-coded calendar in under two minutes.
